description.summary: The subject takes a –4 penalty on Intelligence- based skill checks and Concentration checks due to an endlessly recycling melody stuck in its mind.
description.value: The subject takes a –4 penalty on Intelligence- based skill checks and Concentration checks due to an endlessly recycling melody stuck in its mind. Whenever the subject attempts to cast, concentrate on, or direct a spell, it must succeed on a Concentration check (DC equal to insidious rhythm’s save DC + spell’s level) or fail at the attempt.
